AdditionalNumbers.description: Additional printed numbering never replaces the primary collector number.

cost.description: Ordered energy symbols; an empty list means a printed free attack.

flavourText.description: Printed localised Pokédex flavour text, not an inferred species description.

identityGroup.description: Reviewed identity shared by localised rules records.

identityScope.description: Provisional identity bounded to a printing until shared rules identity is reviewed.

level.description: Numeric level printed on this card; LV.X is a separate mechanic.

symbol.description: Description of the printed symbol, not an image URL or canonical key.

oneOf.description: Physical half; pair membership is represented by a shared collection.

unnumberedKey.description: Derived from the source filename when collectorNumber is explicitly null.

PrintingVariant.description: Each entry is an observed combination; never infer an edition × finish cross product.

contributorToken.description: Maintainer-issued contributor capability; never needed for public reads

info.description: Free, independently curated trading card metadata. Public GET and HEAD requests never require authentication.
info.title: Cardlattice public API

get.summary: Read your submission and review history

head.summary: List the latest 50 immutable snapshots (headers only)

post.summary: Approve or reject a draft atomically
